messages:
Dara (Partnerships): Aurora Systems sent their marketing bundle for marketplace and SI doc. Need quick review: logo fallbacks, co-brand lockup spacing, customer quote reuse, and localized alt text.
Claire (Partner Ops): Files uploaded: https://drive.redwood/partners/aurora_sys/2026_bundle. Items: aurora_logo.svg, aurora_hero.psd, aurora_case_study.pdf, aurora_brand_guidelines.pdf, aurora_locales.csv
Eli (Design): Quick look  their primary mark uses a metallic gradient + bevel. Marketplace forbids bevels/shadows in logos. We need a flat-color fallback and a thicker-stroke variant for <=32px icons.
Noor (PMM): They suggested tagline "Aurora + Redwood: sub-ms inference for RL workloads"  that's a numeric claim. Prefer conservative copy. Draft: "Aurora Systems + Redwood: low-latency inference for production." Thoughts?
Samir (Legal): On the case study: the quote references a named customer and includes a signed release page inside `aurora_case_study.pdf`. I need the separate consent PDF or a clear page with the signature. If it's present we can proceed with attribution.
Claire (Partner Ops): I pulled `aurora_customer_consent_signed.pdf` from the folder (uploaded 2026-09-10 09:02). Also uploaded `aurora_palette_flat.svg` that Aurora provided on request.
Eli (Design): Great. I'll export `aurora_badge_flat.svg`, `aurora_badge_thick.svg`, and `aurora_thumbnail_16x9_v1.jpg` with safe margins. Will include dark/light badge variants for marketplace themes. ETA 2h.
Noor (PMM): For the co-authorship lines, two options: 1) One-liner: "In partnership with Aurora Systems" 2) Two-line: "Built with Aurora Systems
Powered by Redwood Inference." Both factual and safe.
Samir (Legal): Reviewed `aurora_customer_consent_signed.pdf`  the consent covers "marketing materials, web, and third-party marketplace listings" and permits quote reuse with attribution. Legal OK. Add to README: "Consent from Solaris Inc. on 2026-09-09 permits reuse with attribution '— Solaris Inc.'"
Eli (Design): Accessibility note: Aurora's palette fails WCAG on dark backgrounds at a couple of stops. I'll add a recommended contrast variant and `aurora_alt_text_en.md` with canonical English alt text + localization guidance.
Claire (Partner Ops): Aurora wants to include translated alt text (de/es/ja). Recommend we include `alt_text_locales/` placeholder and ask partner to upload final translations after publish-ready review.
Dara (Partnerships): Filename convention: use `partner-aurora-<asset>_v1.<ext>`. Also ask Aurora to approve the short tagline text before we submit to the marketplace. Claire, can you get their PM sign-off?
Claire (Partner Ops): Pinged Aurora PM for copy approval. They replied: "Approve with tiny edit: change 'low-latency' to 'reduced latency.'" I'll update copy.
Noor (PMM): Updated copy: "Aurora Systems + Redwood: reduced latency inference for production." Uploading as `partner-aurora-copy_v1.txt`.
Eli (Design): Uploaded exports with agreed filenames and added `README_usage.md` with the no-bevel rule, clearspace (30px), and lockup spacing (left of Redwood lockup, 36px gap per Aurora request).
UploadBot: Checklist updated: assets-uploaded -> legal-verified -> localization-placeholder -> publish-ready-review scheduled in 24h.
Samir (Legal): Final note: keep attribution exact as provided. Do not paraphrase customer names in quotes.
Dara (Partnerships): Thanks team. Once Aurora PM confirms the final copy and we have the dark/light badges and alt text placeholder, schedule marketplace submission. :thumbsup:
